title: WWII Soldier POV: Stalingrad — The Encirclement Begins
hook: You are holding a ruined building in Stalingrad when the artillery suddenly shifts far beyond the city.
shortDescription: Experience Stalingrad from the first-person perspective of a fictional Soviet rifleman as Operation Uranus begins in November 1942. Cinematic historical reenactment, not archival footage.
longDescription: Enter an immersive first-person historical reenactment set in Stalingrad during 19–23 November 1942. A fictional composite Soviet Red Army rifleman holds a shattered urban position while the massive Soviet counteroffensive known as Operation Uranus develops beyond the city. The episode focuses on rubble, cold, supply runs, short movements between positions and the shift in morale as news of the encirclement arrives. AI-generated cinematic reenactment, not real wartime footage.
